name: Cosmos
summary: Visual inspiration and moodboarding app: save images and links, search by color and get AI captions.
description: Cosmos is an ad-free visual discovery and moodboarding platform for creatives: save images, videos, links and text in collections, search by keyword, hex color or visual similarity, and let AI captions identify the artist or source behind an image. AI-generated content can be flagged, collections can be collaborative, and browser extensions plus imports (Pinterest, Are.na, Tumblr) bring inspiration in. Free on web, iOS and Android; Premium $8/month.
contains: save images, links, videos, articles and text
search by keyword, hex color or visual similarity
AI captions attribute artist/source; AI-image detection
imports from Pinterest, Are.na and Tumblr
web, iOS, Android and browser extensions
